notes: Site is DataDome-protected (blocked earlier HTTP-layer pass documented in notes/207.md), but a real Claude-in-Chrome tab reached it successfully: robots.txt fetched at 200 (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow, only ~90 named crawlers get blanket Disallow: / and Claude is not among them). The visible rendered tab itself got stuck on a DataDome device-check screen while backgrounded/hidden (document.visibilityState='hidden'), but same-origin fetch() calls issued via javascript_tool from that same page context returned real HTML at HTTP 200 (this matches the DataDome-behind-a-hidden-tab pattern the brief calls out as not a real block). Full category tree recovered from /sitemap_2-category.xml (2755 URLs total): the entire Home department nav is Bath, Bedding, Best Sellers, Dining & Entertaining, Fine Art, Home Decor, Home Storage & Organization, Kitchen, Lighting, Luggage & Travel Gear, Sale, Tech Accessories -- there is no standalone Furniture department and no room-based (Living Room/Bedroom/Dining/Office/Outdoor) furniture sections anywhere on the site. A keyword sweep of all 81 /c/home/ sitemap URLs and of the full 2755-URL sitemap for furniture-type terms (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelv, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, ottoman, console, sideboard, vanity) found exactly ONE furniture-relevant node site-wide: Home Decor > 'Accent Furniture & Rugs' (https://www.saksfifthavenue.com/c/home/home-decor/accent-furniture-rugs). All other keyword hits were false positives (Bedding sub-nodes, Dining & Entertaining > Table Linens & Accessories -- textiles, Lighting > Table Lamps, and off-Home editorial 'capsule wardrobe' / 'vanity' beauty content pages). This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's own note that this same node's product tiles were '100% furniture -- tables/chairs/benches/cabinets -- and cowhide/wool area rugs.' The node has no further sub-category split in the mega-menu, the category sitemap, or on-page facets (checked for a refinementValue/Category facet block in the SSR HTML; none found), so it is recorded as a single leaf, not a grouping row. Qty: the SSR page (same-origin fetch of the canonical URL) renders a listing header reading '57 Items' -- taken as the site's own count per Rule 4 method 1. Corroboration: the SSR HTML server-renders an initial batch of 24 unique products (via a stable 'Quick View for {ProductName}' text anchor unique per product; scraping this was more reliable than product-tile img alt text, which is inconsistently populated). Title-classifying that batch: 21/24 are unambiguous furniture (Turner Chenille & Walnut Base Curved Sofa, Hershel Dining Chair, Butterfly Ginkgo Side Table, Eric/Fricke/Seth/Katara/Uma/Turnin/Joplin side and accent tables, Ansel/Barbara/Fincher/Osbourne/Walsh/Marmont bar and counter stools, Jak Iron & Glass Tiered Bar Cart, Meadow Natural Abaca Curved Cocktail Table, Ichigo Textured Console) and 3/24 are non-furniture cross-merchandised into the same bucket (Amity Home Radiance Silk Curtain, Home Silks Hampton Two-Tone Striped Curtain Panel Set -- both textiles/curtains, and MacKenzie-Childs Mrs. Powers Rubber Door Mat -- a mat/rug item). Attempted to page through the remaining ~33 items (start=24&sz=24 on both the canonical URL and a guessed /on/demandware.store/.../Search-UpdateGrid AJAX endpoint) to classify the full 57; the canonical URL with sz= params kept returning only the same first-batch SSR content (server ignores sz on the pretty URL) and the guessed AJAX endpoint returned an unrelated 7KB fragment (a 'tt-teaser-icons' widget, not the product grid), so the true AJAX pagination endpoint/params were not found and the remaining items were not enumerated. Rather than estimate a furniture-only subset qty from a partial sample (forbidden by the project's core accuracy rule), this is recorded per the project's 'mixed category with no split -> take it and flag' precedent (used for 'Beds & Mattresses'-type buckets): qty=57 is the site's own literal total for the combined bucket, flagged as not furniture-purity-filtered. Checked for a Home-department-wide 'Best Sellers'/'Sale' furniture leakage per brief instructions -- both are cross-category rollups per project convention and were not opened. No sofas/beds/dining-tables/desks/etc. found anywhere outside this one node.

rows.evidence: listing header text '57 Items' on the canonical category page (same-origin fetch, HTTP 200); corroborated against first-page SSR product enumeration (24 unique products via 'Quick View for {name}' anchors), of which 21/24 titles are unambiguous furniture (side/accent tables, bar/counter stools, dining chair, sofa, bar cart, console) and 3/24 are non-furniture (2 curtains, 1 rubber door mat) cross-merchandised into the same bucket
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: mixed category -- 'Accent Furniture & Rugs' is the only furniture-relevant node on the entire site (confirmed via full 2755-URL category sitemap keyword sweep plus mega-menu walk) and it also contains rugs, curtains, and at least one door mat alongside furniture, with no furniture-only sub-split, facet, or separate URL provided by the site. qty=57 is the site's own total for the combined bucket, not filtered to furniture-only; a full item-by-item classification of all 57 (vs. the 24 sampled) could not be completed because the site's AJAX pagination/grid-update endpoint could not be located from the SSR markup (guessed Search-UpdateGrid endpoint returned an unrelated widget fragment).
